name: Velvet Casa
tagline: Italian upholstered furniture, tailored to your interior
niche: Italian upholstered furniture showroom: sofas, armchairs, beds

listing.description: A website for a premium furniture showroom: a dark hall with a sofa under a spotlight and switchable upholstery, collections with Roman numerals, a wine-list price menu and a brass thread through the order path.

seo.title: Velvet Casa — Italian sofas and armchairs in Tashkent
seo.description: An Italian upholstered furniture showroom on Amir Temur: sofas, armchairs and beds made to order in 300 fabrics. Fabric samples to your home, delivery and placement.
seo.answer: Velvet Casa is an Italian upholstered furniture showroom in Tashkent at 107B Amir Temur Ave. Made-to-order sofas start at 38,000,000 UZS, armchairs at 14,500,000 UZS, beds at 29,000,000 UZS; over 300 fabrics, made in Italy in 8–12 weeks. We bring fabric samples to your home free of charge.

sections.title: Softness you can see
sections.subtitle: Sofas, armchairs and beds from Brianza workshops, sewn to your size and your fabric. Pick a velvet colour and the sofa changes.

sections.label: Showroom
sections.title: Furniture you choose once
sections.text: Velvet Casa is a 600 m² hall on Amir Temur where every model can be touched and every fabric held against a sample of your wall. We work with three family workshops in Brianza that sew each sofa by hand to your measurements. Our designer comes to measure and shows how the piece will sit in your room.

items.title: Lago
items.text: Low modules that form a corner, an island or a straight run. Feather-filled cushions.

items.title: Duna
items.text: Rounded, deep-seated armchairs in velvet and bouclé. Swivel base on request.

items.title: Notte
items.text: Soft headboards up to the ceiling, linen storage, sizes from 160 to 200 cm.

items.title: Terra
items.text: Walnut, travertine and brass — tables that hold the composition around the sofa.

sections.label: Models & prices
sections.title: Showroom prices
sections.intro: “From” prices are for the model in a category A base fabric. The total depends on size, fabric and filling; we calculate it with you.

items.title: Lago corner sofa
items.text: Left or right corner, up to 5 modules.

items.title: Duna pouf
items.text: To match the armchair or on its own.

sections.label: How to order
sections.title: From fabric to the first evening

items.title: Visit the showroom
items.text: Try the models, choose the size and a fabric from 300 samples.

items.title: Measuring & plan
items.text: A designer comes to your home and prepares a layout and a render.

items.title: Made in Italy
items.text: The workshop sews to your measurements in 8–12 weeks; we send you photos from the floor.

items.title: Delivery & placement
items.text: We deliver, unpack, place to plan and take the packaging away.

items.quote: We waited ten weeks for the sofa and never regretted it: it is exactly the green we were looking for.
items.author: Sevara and Otabek

items.quote: The designer brought fabric samples to the flat and held them against the curtains. That settled it.
items.author: Nargiza

items.q: How long does a made-to-order piece take?
items.a: 8–12 weeks from the deposit: the workshop sews to your measurements, then it ships to Tashkent.
Yes, floor models are sold at a discount and delivered in 2–3 days.
A 50% deposit when ordering, the rest before delivery. Cash, card or bank transfer.

items.q: Can I get fabric samples at home?
items.a: Yes, we bring up to 10 samples free of charge within Tashkent.

sections.label: Showroom
sections.title: Come in for an espresso
sections.text: 107B Amir Temur, second floor. Free parking at the entrance.
